skill_name: Speculate on how artificial intelligence will change the social landscape
workflow: Artificial intelligence is expected to have a considerable impact on the social landscape. It could have implications for how people find jobs, access education, interact with each other and make decisions. AI has the potential to reduce human labour and provide new and more efficient ways to interact with the world.
